🔧 Shop Buddy

Starting up…

🔧 Join a shop

Get the shop code and password from your buddy. It's on their CYD under the walkie-talkie button, then NET.

Pick a photo of your face and every shop sees it on your mechanic.

📷 Your picture

It goes on your mechanic's face and every shop you're linked with sees it.

Tap your mechanic, the car, the cat, or the buttons, just like on the CYD. The walkie-talkie button (right side) lets you toss tools, visit, borrow, prank or holler at the other shops. To link to a real CYD, open the gear (settings) and tap CODE. Tap once to turn the sound on.
